description:
One preset in force, and what it means for the media it applies to — the
operator's question answered in their own terms, with no scoring vocabulary.

means.description: What it means, in the operator's terms rather than the tool's.

needs_transcoding_here.description:
Whether this host would have to transcode it in software — the caution
stated before a choice a household cannot smoothly play.

resolution.description: The resolution and encode it targets.

scope.description: What this applies to: `everything`, or a specific media type.

size_per_hour.description: Roughly how much disk an hour of it takes.

transcoding.description: What playback costs, in plain terms.
